subtasks.description: Declare sequential state: 4-bit round counter rcnt (0–9) and four 32-bit registers w0, w1, w2, w3 holding the current round key words.
constraints: Use scalar 32-bit registers w0, w1, w2, w3; do not use an unpacked array.

subtasks.description: Instantiate a single aes_sbox module for combinational byte substitution used in SubWord. Connect byte input and output with appropriate signals.
constraints: Purely combinational instantiation; no sequential logic.

subtasks.description: Derive an 8-bit round constant (Rcon) combinationally from rcnt, using a lookup table or shift-based method. Only the highest byte is valid; lower bytes are zero.
constraints: Output must be combinational and respond immediately to rcnt changes.

subtasks.description: Implement pure combinational key expansion datapath: rotate w3, feed byte to sbox, XOR SubWord result with Rcon, then XOR chain with current words w0..w3 to produce next_w0, next_w1, next_w2, next_w3.
constraints: Do not store intermediate values; all computations feed-forward.
If using a single sbox instance, multiplex the appropriate rotated w3 byte into it.
Use separate scalar wires for next_w0, next_w1, next_w2, next_w3.

subtasks.description: Sequential always block: on posedge clk with synchronous reset, if kld load initial_key into w0..w3 and clear rcnt; else if expansion active, load next_w0..next_w3 into w0..w3, increment rcnt, and assign round_key <= {w0,w1,w2,w3}.
constraints: round_key must be registered; do not drive combinationally.
Use scalar signal assignments for w0..w3 and next_w0..next_w3.
